reddit.title: Introducing Materials Instead of Cost Badges in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update in Provincia! Instead of the previous cost badges, build tiles now display a detailed **Materials** sheet. This allows you to see all the materials required for your constructions at a glance, with shortages highlighted. No more guessing what you need! Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
